newsitem.title: USA: Sportscaster Marv Albert in court on sex charges. [CORRECTED 19:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Sportscaster Marv Albert in court on sex charges. [CORRECTED 19:45 GMT]

text.p: A lawyer for veteran NBC sportscaster Marv Albert told an Arlington court Tuesday Albert would plead not guilty to charges that he sexually assaulted a woman in a hotel room here last February.
At an arraignment in Arlington Circuit Court, Judge Benjamin Kendrick set Sept. 22 for a jury trial.
Albert's lawyer Gerard Treanor said he was not yet ready to enter a formal plea because he said "a number of analyses" were still being carried out on Albert's behalf. He gave no further details.

Albert was allowed to remain free but would forfeit $1,000 if he failed to appear as required by the court. He was taken away for booking in the local County detention centre where police said he would be photographed and fingerprinted.

Albert, 53, was indicted last week for allegedly biting the woman several times on the back and on a separate charge of forcing her to perform oral sex after the two got into an argument in his hotel room shortly after midnight Feb. 12.

The 42-year-old woman told police that Albert, a friend of hers for about 10 years, invited her to join him in his hotel room after a New York Knicks-Washington Bullets basketball game. In addition to his NBC appearances, Albert also does play-by-play for the Knicks and hockey's New York Rangers.
